## Functions

### `captureRealmOperatorContextObservationSource(...args)`

Kernel-private access to the original adapter's retained coherent cut. Historical lookup proves issuer identity only. Capture/currentness require the original live work root and never start another observation or head read. The companion exposes no writer, root controller or source-close authority.

### `captureRealmOperatorContextLineageSource(...args)`

Historical exact boot/composition/coordinator lineage only. These guards neither inspect candidates nor observe, authorize, or revive an adapter.

### `createRealmOperatorContextAdapter(options)`

One-shot B4A operatorContext@1 facade over one genuine boot head observation and one original host attempt. Exact frozen options are { bootBinding, lifecycleComposition, operatorContext }; both original private companions must retain that exact coordinator, not merely equal account/generation text. The first valid snapshot request consumes the genuine construction root and shares one pending promise. The retained observation supplies all six fields. assertCurrent/subscribe require that attempt's original work root. Successful publication detaches construction cancellation; work/teardown or observation loss irreversibly stops the facade. No later attempt or head is adopted. Generic staleness proves no particular head changed. This facade first stops itself and then reports only service-stopped to every still-live subscriber. close() drains its pending read and disposes its observation; it never closes the boot binding, owner, composition, shared manager, or host signal roots. No lifecycle generation, B4F provider, Entry activation or isolation is added.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```
